title.narrative: Higher Education and Academic Research _ Supplementary Funds

description.narrative: The programme promotes inclusive, high-quality, and integrated higher education systems across Eastern Africa. It leverages a programming pipeline that connects national research and innovation capacities, doctoral studies, and student mobility with tertiary skilling systems to prepare young Africans for employability, entrepreneurship, and lifelong learning. Strategic investments target key sectors for job creation, inclusive growth, and sustainable development, including agriculture (smart agriculture, sustainable water management, climate resilience), renewable energy, and technological innovation (digital technologies and artificial intelligence). The programme advances gender-transformative higher technical and STEM education to ensure equitable access and impact, and is aligned with UNESCO's Campus Africa flagship programme.
